verdict.rationale: No source describes a bulk-action feature, but there is indirect evidence of handling many items at once. Automation rules handle mail automatically according to user-set rules, multiple checks can be deposited together, packages can be bundled for shipping, and an API and Zapier integration could support scripted batch processing. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk-select or bulk-action feature for mail items (scan, forward, shred, archive), documented batch API endpoints, a published API spec (OpenAPI paths return 404), and hands-on or independent corroboration.
